sources.title: Musik: Wegen Tinnitus: Duran-Duran-Drummer Roger Taylor hört auf
Duran Duran Drummer Roger Taylor Exits Group and Retires Following Tinnitus Diagnosis
Duran Duran’s Roger Taylor Retires From Group After Tinnitus Diagnosis: “I Must Now Listen to My Body and My Doctors”

en.title: Duran Duran drummer Roger Taylor retires from group after tinnitus diagnosis
en.dek: Band announces departure of drummer following worsening tinnitus
facts: Duran Duran announced on social media that drummer Roger Taylor is retiring from the band and drumming.
Taylor said the decision was one of the hardest he had ever made, citing that his tinnitus has been getting steadily worse.
Taylor first joined Duran Duran in 1978, appeared on the band's first three albums, and left the group in 1985.
Taylor rejoined Duran Duran in 2001 and contributed to six albums, most recently on 2023's Danse Macabre.
Bandmates Simon Le Bon, Nick Rhodes and John Taylor called Taylor their 'brother' and said they completely support his decision.
body: Duran Duran announced on Thursday that drummer Roger Taylor is retiring from the band and from drumming, the group said on social media.
Taylor stated the decision was one of the hardest he had ever made, adding that his tinnitus has been getting steadily worse and that he must now listen to his body and his doctors.
As part of Duran Duran, Taylor rose to prominence in the 1980s and rejoined the group in 2001, contributing to six albums most recently on 2023's Danse Macabre.
Bandmates Simon Le Bon, Nick Rhodes and John Taylor called Taylor their 'brother' and said they completely support his decision and wish him health and happiness.
en.context: Roger Taylor first joined Duran Duran in 1978 and remained with the group until 1985 before returning in 2001.
en.imageCaption: Roger Taylor of Duran Duran Gary Miller/Getty Images

de.title: Roger Taylor, Schlagzeuger von Duran Duran, tritt nach Tinnitus-Diagnose zurück
de.dek: Band gibt Austritt des Schlagzeugers nach verschlechterndem Tinnitus bekannt
facts: Duran Duran gab in den sozialen Medien bekannt, dass Schlagzeuger Roger Taylor die Band und das Schlagzeugspiel verlässt.
Taylor sagte, die Entscheidung sei eine der schwierigsten, die er je treffen musste, und führte dies darauf zurück, dass sein Tinnitus stetig schlimmer geworden sei.
Taylor stieß 1978 zu Duran Duran, erschien auf den ersten drei Alben der Band und verließ die Gruppe 1985.
Taylor stieß 2001 zu Duran Duran und trug zu sechs Alben bei, zuletzt auf dem 2023er Album Danse Macabre.
Bandkollegen Simon Le Bon, Nick Rhodes und John Taylor nannten Taylor ihren „Bruder“ und sagten, sie unterstützten seine Entscheidung voll und ganz.
body: Duran Duran gab am Donnerstag bekannt, dass Schlagzeuger Roger Taylor aus der Band und vom Schlagzeug zurücktritt, wie die Gruppe in den sozialen Medien mitteilte.

Taylor erklärte, die Entscheidung sei eine der schwierigsten, die er je getroffen habe, und fügte hinzu, dass sein Tinnitus stetig schlimmer werde und er nun auf seinen Körper und seine Ärzte hören müsse.
Als Teil von Duran Duran erlangte Taylor in den 1980er Jahren Bekanntheit und trat 2001 wieder der Gruppe bei, wobei er an sechs Alben mitgewirkt hat, zuletzt an „Danse Macabre“ von 2023.
Bandmitglieder Simon Le Bon, Nick Rhodes und John Taylor nannten Taylor ihren „Bruder“ und erklärten, sie unterstützten seine Entscheidung voll und ganz und wünschten ihm Gesundheit und Glück.
de.context: Roger Taylor stieß 1978 zu Duran Duran und blieb bis 1985 in der Gruppe, bevor er 2001 zurückkehrte.
de.imageCaption: Roger Taylor von Duran Duran Gary Miller/Getty Images

pt.title: Roger Taylor, baterista do Duran Duran, reforma-se do grupo após diagnóstico de tinnitus
pt.dek: Banda anuncia a saída do baterista após agravamento do tinnitus
facts: O Duran Duran anunciou nas redes sociais que o baterista Roger Taylor se reforma da banda e da bateria
Taylor disse que a decisão foi uma das mais difíceis que tomou, citando que o seu tinnitus tem piorado progressivamente
Taylor juntou-se ao Duran Duran pela primeira vez em 1978, participou nos três primeiros álbuns da banda e deixou o grupo em 1985
Taylor regressou ao Duran Duran em 2001 e contribuiu para seis álbuns, mais recentemente no *Danse Macabre* de 2023
Os colegas de banda Simon Le Bon, Nick Rhodes e John Taylor chamaram Taylor de 'irmão' e disseram que apoiam totalmente a sua decisão
body: Duran Duran anunciou na quinta-feira que o baterista Roger Taylor está a abandonar o grupo e a tocar bateria, segundo a banda nas redes sociais.
Taylor afirmou que a decisão foi uma das mais difíceis que já tomou, acrescentando que o seu tinnitus tem piorado progressivamente e que agora tem de ouvir o seu corpo e os médicos.
Como parte do Duran Duran, Taylor ganhou destaque nos anos 80 e regressou ao grupo em 2001, contribuindo para seis álbuns, sendo o mais recente o de 2023, Danse Macabre.
Os colegas de banda Simon Le Bon, Nick Rhodes e John Taylor chamaram a Taylor de "irmão" e disseram que apoiam totalmente a sua decisão e desejam-lhe saúde e felicidade.
pt.context: Roger Taylor juntou-se ao Duran Duran em 1978 e permaneceu no grupo até 1985, antes de regressar em 2001.
pt.imageCaption: Roger Taylor do Duran Duran Gary Miller/Getty Images

problemsFixed: 'retires from music' is not in sources; sources only state retirement from the band and drumming.
'tinnitus diagnosis' appears in headline but not explicitly stated as a medical diagnosis in S1 (only 'due to Tinnitus').
Facts list contains invented phrasing not verbatim from sources (e.g. 'Roger Taylor announced his retirement... due to worsening tinnitus' combines claims from multiple sources without attribution).
Body paragraph 1 ends with an evaluative summary ('following a recent tinnitus diagnosis').
Context paragraph repeats information from facts/body and opens with same noun as previous paragraph.
Category 'sport' is incorrect for a music retirement.
Sources disagree on exact timeline of rejoining; S2 says 'until now', S3 says 'up until now' — need careful neutral phrasing.
